Character sprites extracted from Koisuru Kimochi no Kasanekata
(恋する気持ちのかさねかた).

Due to the large number of character sprites and expression variants,
the complete character sprite collection has been divided into two galleries.

The collection includes the available full-body character sprites and
their expression variants extracted from the game resources.

This gallery is Part 2 of 2 and the final part of the character sprite collection.

从《恋する気持ちのかさねかた（Koisuru Kimochi no Kasanekata）》
游戏资源中提取的人物立绘。

由于本作人物立绘及表情差分数量较多，
完整的人物立绘合集共分为两个画廊上传。

本合集收录从游戏资源中提取的可用全身人物立绘及其表情差分。

本画廊为人物立绘合集第二卷，共两卷，
同时也是本合集的最后一卷。
